title: ai-news-channel episode-folder-provisioning script is committed to GitHub, not local-only
fix: The episode-folder provisioning tool (Prepare-EpisodeFolders.ps1 + its Prepare_Episode_Folders.bat launcher, plus README.md) lives at 03_Spotify_Podcast/tools/episode-sync/ in begb0037admin/ai-news-channel and IS version-controlled on GitHub main — contrary to an assumption that it might be local-clone-only.
